outline:
透過本課程，使學生：
1.能瞭解英文科核心能力及專業知能。
2.能編製教材與教案。
3.能依據教材與教案執行教學。
4.能建置個人學習檔案與教學心得報告。
5.能熟知相關領域最新發展趨勢，並收集資訊以輔助教學及進行教材編修。
schedule:
Week 1  Course Introduction
Week 2  Approaches to ELT
Week 3  Lesson Planning
Week 4  Teaching Listening
Week 5  Teaching Speaking
Week 6  Teaching Reading
Week 7  Teaching Writing
Week 8  Classroom Observation I
Week 9  Midterm Exam
Week 10	Classroom Observation II
Week 11	International Education
Week 12	English Remedial Instruction
Week 13	Differentiated Instruction
Week 14	Language Assessment
Week 15	Evaluating ELT textbooks and materials
Week 16	Computer Assisted Language Learning
Week 17	Language Education Policies
Week 18	Final Exam
assessment:
Lesson Plans (first draft + revised version)  20%
Presentation & Report  20%
Attendance and participation  15%
Midterm & Final exams 30%
Classroom Observation Reports  15%
materials:
【遵守智慧財產權觀念，請使用正版教科書，不得使用非法影印教科書】

使用外文原文書：

1. Brown, H. D. (2001). Teaching by Principles: An interactive approach to language pedagogue, Second Edition. White Plains, NY: Pearson Education.
2. Brown, H. D. (2000). Principles of Language Learning and Teaching, Fourth Edition. White Plains, NY: Pearson Education.
3. Larsen-Freeman, D. (2011). Techniques and principles in language teaching (3rd ed.). New York, NY: Oxford University Press.
4. Lightbown, P. M., & Spada, N. (2006). How Language are Learned (Third Edition). Oxford, UK: Oxford University Press.
5. Nunan, D. (2004). Syllabus Design. Oxford, UK: Oxford University Press.
